argv:
cpus=$(nproc)
    running=$(awk "{split(\$4,a,\"/\"); print a[1]}" /proc/loadavg)
    echo "cpus=$cpus runnable=$running"
    free -h
    test "$running" -le "$((cpus * 2))"
